mapper.select: SELECT id, nickname, phone, email, password_hash AS passwordHash, avatar_url AS avatarUrl, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM users WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, nickname, phone, email, password_hash, avatar_url, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE phone = #{account} OR email = #{account} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (nickname, phone, email, password_hash, avatar_url, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{nickname}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{avatarUrl}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET nickname = #{nickname}, avatar_url = #{avatarUrl}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
